You have less than 24 hours left to score a Nintendo Switch 2 console before tomorrow’s price hike, and all of today’s deals await below.

Apple deals starting to disappear, grab AirTag 2 at the best price ever while you still can ($20 each)

The massive Labor Day sale at Amazon got off to an early start this year again, but some of the most notable Apple deals are already starting to disappear and you might want to score this one before it’s gone – the new AirTag 2 is still sitting at its best price ever.

Amazon is currently offering the single AirTag 2 listing down at its lowest price to date – you can land single at $24 Prime shipped right now.

However, the real banger deal and one some folks around here are referring to as one of the best Apple deals of the year is the 4-pack down at $79.99 shipped.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (Reg. $99) – NEW all-time low

This is the lowest price ever offered, bringing Apple’s upgraded 2026 item trackers down to just $20 pop. And any time you can score a new piece of Apple kit for $20 Prime shipped it is worth consideration.

Wild deals live on Apple gear via Amazon Resale: Up to 60% off MagSafe Battery, AirPods, Apple Pencil, more

Amazon’s 2026 Labor Day is seriously flying now and, while there are some great deals live on brand new condition gear, there are some wild discounts on Apple gear courtesy of Amazon Resale right now – it is offering up to an additional 30% off gear at checkout. Details below.

The all-time low pricing on AirTag 2 from $20 each is still live alongside the AirPods Pro 3 deal and the early M6 Mac mini pre-order discounts, but there are also some seriously notable deals around right now on Apple accessories if you’re quick.

All of the deals below come in the form of Amazon Resale offers in the best quality it offers:

  • Apple Pencil Pro $74 shipped (Reg. $129 new)
  • Apple Pencil USB-C $55 (Reg. $69)
  • iPhone Air MagSafe Battery $39 (Reg. $99 new)

***Note: Opt for the “Resale – Like New” listings once you have clicked through the links above.

Satechi’s M6/M5 Pro/M4 Mac mini Hub & Stand with SSD enclosure now down at $65 (35% off)

We are tracking some pre-order discounts on the brand new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro model as part of Amazon’s Labor Day sale. But those offers are now joined by Satechi’s purpose-built Mac mini Hub & Stand with NVMe SSD Enclosure at a solid 35% off – it is compatible with the M6, M5 Pro, and M4 Mac mini.

The official Satechi Amazon storefront is now offering its Mac mini Hub & Stand with NVMe SSD Enclosure down at $64.74 shipped – the clip the on-page coupon to redeem the discounted rate.

This thing carries a $100 list price and rarely drops below $75 when on sale. Today’s deal undercuts our previous 25% off mention to deliver 36% in savings and one of the best prices of the year.

It is indeed the same model the brand released last year for the M4 Mac mini, but it is just as compatible with the all-new M6 and M5 Pro models Apple just debuted and put up for pre-order last week. You will find some clone knock off hubs like this out there, but Satechi’s is the real thing, delivering a look and feel that almost feels like it was designed in Cupertino.

Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro units now up to $291 off [Updated]

Update 8/26: Prices have now dropped even lower:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,215 (Reg. $1,499 new) – all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,215 (Reg. $1,499 new) – all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new) – all-time low

  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,171 (Reg. $1,299 new) – all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,170 (Reg. $1,299 new) – all-time low

While the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is my go-to recommendation for landing deals on iPhone, Apple does not sell its latest iPhone 17 Pro models there yet, and it looks like it won’t until after the 18 series lands next month. Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed listings have now returned to Prime Day pricing at up to $220 off the new list prices.

Amazon’s top-quality Premium Renewed units have been the best option for landing deals on unlocked iPhone 17 Pro units thus far. Not only are you saving hundreds, but you’re also landing the 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life” – the not “premium” renewed and refurbished listings on Amazon only come with a 90-day warranty and you won’t get the same battery life grate either.

Most affordable 24GB M5 MacBook Air you can buy is $150 off today

Deals on the latest M5 MacBook Air have been relatively hard to come by outside of the official Apple refurb store since the price hikes took hold. We have seen a couple solid, albeit short-lived, offers on the Sky Blue models at Amazon, but today we spotted the most affordable 24GB model you can buy in Silver at $150 off.

B&H is now offering Apple’s 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB of RAM and the 512GB SSD down at $1,449 shipped.

This is a $1,599 configuration seeing a straight up $150 pice drop. The other colors are on sale as well there, but they are $100 off.

You’re looking at a configuration you’ll only find at smaller authorized dealers, straight from Apple, and official Apple dealers like B&H. The only 24GB M5 MacBook Air Amazon carries has the larger 1TB storage capacity and a $1,799 list price (it is currently $100 off though) – this model we are featuring here today is the least expensive 24GB config you can buy.

Amazon now offering pre-order discounts on two most affordable new M6 Mac mini models

After just launching its massive Labor Day sale, Amazon has decided it really wants your M6 Mac mini pre-order – it has now dropped the price a touch on the two most affordable configurations. The deals aren’t massive, but it is literally the only reputable place to land the brand new mini M6 with a deal right now. Just make sure you go scoop up an Apple Polishing Cloth at $9 Prime shipped before they sell out completely.

Late yesterday afternoon we spotted Amazon dropping the MSRP on the base model 16GB/256GB and now you can also add the mid-range 16GB/512GB model to the discount list:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,699

We are clearly looking at light discounts here, considering the new mini starts at $899, but I mean, these things haven’t even released yet (delivery starts on September 22). And if you’re going to be pre-ordering without trade-in you might as well keep some gas or coffee money in your pocket in the process.

As of right now, and very much as expected, the brand new M6 Mac mini is still sitting at full price from other authorized Apple retailers and, of course, straight from Apple. We are yet to see the 24GB M6 or M5 Pro model drop in price at all, but we will keep an eye out.
